scope: P4 Task 1 evidence back-fill: 10 priority drugs (alogliptin, trandolapril, methyldopa, exenatide, rosiglitazone, pramlintide, terazosin, saxagliptin, furosemide, vildagliptin). 80 live RAG queries (8/drug) via balade-pubmed-rag-bot.hf.space, 240 snippets adjudicated by 2 independent oracle lanes (ora-8 diabetes 6 drugs, ora-10 AH/cardio 4 drugs; ora-9 failed with no payload and was re-dispatched as ora-10).
evidence_path: rag-queries/l3_output/*/backfill_*.json (80 files, full-length snippets), rag-queries/backfill_queries.py, rag-queries/backfill_summary.json
outcome: All current L4 values retained (0 changes). Universal blocker: endpoint truncates snippet text at ~512 chars, cutting all quantitative values mid-sentence; off-drug rate 40-60% (same-class drugs dominate) despite drug-name-first queries. methyldopa pool worst (confusable-name returns: MDMA/methylphenidate/methylone). Class-anchored values are conservative estimates, not confirmed by this evidence. No data corruption: 0 overwrites, 80 new files, schema-validated.
blocker_for_fix: RAG endpoint must return full abstracts (or much larger cap) for quantitative evidence extraction to succeed.
